name: Social buddy profile
annotation: HIFI-83 · /profile/[id] · dark shell, top radial orange glow, warm-light parity not required. Buddy Hero Card (avatar + relationship copy + trust pills + SharedDomainShape) is the dominant focal moment; CIA insight card holds one consented pattern; shared missions render as non-shaming progress rows below; bottom actions handle visibility and message.

modules.build: Dark status bar, 44px target for back chevron '<' and overflow '...'. Back label: 'Buddy profile'.

GlassCard r40. Center content. Avatar slot HIFI-83-01 initials 'AK'. Name: 'Aisha Khan'. Body copy: 'Running partner. We're training for the *half* together.' (*half* uses Newsreader Medium Italic). Pills: [Trusted partner] green bg #34A853/16%, check glyph; [Mutual insight] purple bg #7F24FF/16%. SharedDomainShape constellation draws below pills: 'Fitness + Learning'.
GlassCard r24. Purple accent left border. Copy: 'on mutually shared run days, both sleep logs were higher.' Provenance chip: 'via shared consent + check-ins'.

Overline 'SHARED MISSIONS'. SolidCard #211008 r24. Row 1: 'Run a half marathon', ProgressBar 68% (orange #FF5E00 fill), status 'on track', chip 'via check-ins'. Row 2: 'Read 2 books', ProgressBar 35% (orange #FF5E00 fill), status 'building', chip 'via updates'.
Overline 'NETWORK'. Pills row: 'Permissions', 'Invite', 'Safety'. BtnSecondary [Adjust visibility] opens Sheet. BtnPrimary [Message] routes to /messages.

belowFold.build: Sheet opens half-height. Toggles: Health, Photo, Voice, Social profile. Controls: Mute, Remove buddy, Report, Block, Export shared data, Revoke shared domains, Delete shared history.

imageSlots.desc: Initials avatar placeholder 'AK' until photo consent exists.

trustControls: Adjust visibility sheet exposes per-domain consent toggles for health, photo, voice, and social profile
Export shared data available before revoking access
Revoke shared domains and delete shared history with confirmation
Report and block route to screen 64
Mute and remove buddy controls in the visibility sheet
Avatar image opens Image Viewer only when media consent exists
Shared health/CIA insight requires mutual, per-category consent before rendering; falls back to 'No shared insight yet' otherwise
notes: Disabled state dims Message, invite, shared mission rows, visibility toggles, avatar open, and CIA insight actions to 40% with reason copy when blocked, removed, pending, consent-missing, offline, or moderation-limited. Pending state dims Message with explicit reason. Removed state shows a reconnect banner and keeps Message visible with an explanation that messaging requires an accepted connection — never silently hidden. Error state keeps identity but shows retry for failed mission sync. Honest-null: missing shared missions renders 'No shared missions yet' with an Invite to mission action; missing shared consent renders 'No shared insight yet' in place of the CIA card; missing photo keeps the initials avatar.
